text: OOO "Zevs" (OGRN 1197746286924) holds 97.5% of OOO "BK Olimp", the company behind Olimpbet; BK Olimp's general director Sergey Gennadyevich Kozyavkin holds the remaining 2.5% (EGRUL founder data).
short: OOO Zevs owns 97.5% of BK Olimp
